verdict.rationale: Godot ships stable, versioned language docs for both GDScript and C# (godot-docs-1, godot-docs-2), which supports the 'well-documented API' half of the story, but there is no direct evidence about LLM-generated code success rates, and GDScript is a custom, Godot-specific language with much smaller training-data footprint than mainstream languages — community comments call it 'poorly documented' and 'awful' compared to Python (godot-comm-14, godot-comm-15), while others found it easy to learn (godot-comm-16), showing mixed real-world experience even for humans. Missing for 10: any evidence of actual LLM code-generation success/failure rates, benchmarks, or AI-specific tooling feedback on GDScript correctness, and no llms.txt/machine-readable docs mirror exists (godot-probe-1, godot-probe-2) to aid model grounding.
